# G.722 codec

ITU-T G.722 encoder and decoder from [sippy/libg722](https://github.com/sippy/libg722),
commit `a2688d2123d36f2d4392a1a92e1a8132a3eaceda`, copied unchanged. Used by `Core/src/bsk_g722.c`.

License: see `LICENSE`. The code is based on the CMU 1993 ADPCM program (use unrestricted)
and Steve Underwood's implementation (public domain); Sippy Software's changes are under the
2-clause BSD license.
